retrievalProfile.description: A vintage 1970s soul aesthetic featuring a trio of men in a layered portrait with halftone-textured display typography.

recipe.visualDefinition: A three-person portrait composition where figures are layered at varying depths against a dark background, paired with heavy sans-serif display text filled with a multi-colored halftone dot pattern.
coreVisualRelationships: Triangular arrangement of subjects creating depth
Textured typography contrasting with smooth photographic skin tones
Warm, low-key lighting emphasizing facial expressions
Circular graphic element in the upper right balancing the top-left text
coreInvariants: Halftone dot pattern fill within the primary display text
Layered portraiture with one figure significantly closer to the foreground
Dark, textured background that recedes behind the subjects

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Three men arranged in a diagonal recession; the rightmost figure is largest in the foreground, the leftmost is mid-ground, and the center figure is slightly recessed.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, smiling face of the man in the bottom right foreground.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the vibrant text in the top left, moves down to the leftmost figure, across to the central figure, and settles on the large foreground figure on the right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Deep shadows and dark textures surrounding the heads and shoulders of the subjects.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep browns and blacks in the background and shadows.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Warm tans, creams, and light blues in the clothing.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Cyan, magenta, and yellow dots within the halftone text.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation in the photography with high-value highlights on faces; high saturation in the typographic dot patterns.

letterConstructionRules: Filled with a coarse, multi-colored halftone dot screen
characterSpecificRedesigns: The interior of the glyphs is replaced by a CMYK dot pattern rather than solid color
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A secondary small circular badge with centered sans-serif text provides a geometric counterpoint to the main block.

avoid: Solid color fills for display text

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the sturdy, geometric skeleton of the display type.
Provides the necessary weight and tight counters for the halftone fill.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a vintage 1970s style photograph of three men in a soul band, layered in a triangular composition with warm lighting and a dark, textured background.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply a large, three-line stacked block of extra-bold sans-serif text in the top left, using a CMYK halftone dot pattern as the fill texture.

verificationChecks: Is the text filled with a visible halftone dot pattern?
Are there three distinct figures in a layered portrait?
Is the lighting warm and vintage in tone?
Is the typography stacked and left-aligned?

mustRedesign: Do not use solid flat colors for the main title
Ensure the portrait layering feels organic rather than a flat collage
postGenerationChecks: Check that the halftone dots are multi-colored (CMYK style)
Verify the text is extra-bold and stacked
Ensure the background is dark and textured
Confirm the subjects have a warm, vintage photographic quality
recipe.reuseFormula: Layered Portrait + Halftone-Filled Bold Sans-Serif + 70s Warm Color Grade
